title: McCluskey
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of 9 muscle-ups, 15 burpee pull-ups, 21 pull-ups and an 800 m run, ideally in a vest, for time. Honours U.S. Army Sgt. Jason 'Mick' McCluskey, killed by small-arms fire in Afghanistan in 2010. A lot of pulling: swap muscle-ups for chest-to-bar or banded reps if needed.

source.title: McCluskey – CrossFit Hero WOD

items.name: 3 rounds
items.note: Wear a 20/14 lb (9/6.5 kg) weight vest or body armour if you have one.
